rawResults.Snippet: First, install the Microsoft.VisualStudio.BenchmarkDotNetDiagnosers NuGet package in your benchmarking project. Next add one or more of the Visual Studio diagnosers to your benchmark to capture the relevant profiling information while benchmarking. Lastly, run your benchmarks and a diagsession will be generated. If run from Visual Studio the diagsession will automatically be opened.
